content.text: {"headline":"Approve R1: overtime on both queues, UPI outage message and chat deflection brings 11:15-13:15 service level to 85.2% for ₹9,738","why":"Payments calls hit 220 at 11:00 against 128.7 forecast, driven by upi_payment_failed (2.2x normal, 103 excess calls). This looks like a UPI failure, though no incident ticket exists yet, so ask IT to confirm and open one. With no action, service level over 11:15-13:15 is predicted at 24.7% (payments 13.1%) with 21.6% abandons. R1 is the cheapest policy-compliant plan that reaches the 80% target. It delays breaks on both queues by 45 minutes, offers overtime to 36 payments and 8 general agents, plays a UPI known-issue message, and deflects 20% of selected enquiries to chat on both queues. Predicted result: 85.2% overall (payments 82.0%, general 90.8%), 3.2% abandons, and 87.4% for the rest of the day.","trade_offs":["P3 costs ₹1,674 less (₹8,064) but falls just short of target at 79.9%, with payments at 76.6%. That leaves no margin if the outage worsens.","R2 costs ₹1,026 more (₹10,764) and performs slightly worse (84.3%), so it adds nothing over R1.","The cheaper options all stay well below target. P2 reaches 45.8% for ₹864 and P4 reaches 56.1% for ₹6,480. P0 and P1 cost nothing but leave payments around 13%.","R1 also protects General: deflection plus 8 overtime agents lifts it from 47.1% (no action) to 90.8%. General's drop isn't fully explained by its own volume, so this guards against knock-on pressure from payments.","R1 relies on 44 agents accepting overtime and on customers taking up chat deflection. Lower uptake on either could pull payments back toward the 80% line."],"watch":"Check overtime acceptance by 11:45, especially the 36 payments agents. Watch payments service level and upi_payment_failed volume each interval. Confirm the outage with IT and update the IVR message if the scope or end time changes. If the outage runs past 13:15 or payments stays below 80%, review again."}
